soph: I'll handle on-prem guidance & runbook. Documenting conntrack thresholds and mitigation steps; will coordinate maintenance window with accounts.

ben: Routing replication race is my item. Small patch in `fix/route-guard` adds an `applied_at` guard. Need review + canary.

infra-bot: Channel #incident-centauri-1729801234 created. RED-901 linked.

ana: Timeline: owners acked: peering->@viktor, runbook->@soph, routing->@ben. Deliverables due next Fri COB. Weekly checks for 4 weeks after rollout.

viktor: ack. Test plan will include `peering-flapper` run in staging and BFD verification.

soph: ack. Proposed maintenance window 2026-04-05 02:00-04:00 UTC.

ben: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/3333
